title: fix: prevent thinking-only replies from utility models
body:
Related: #153391. Follow-up to #169331.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes empty utility results when a local reasoning model spends its short output allowance entirely on thinking.

## User Impact

Titles, observer digests, progress narration, activity recaps, and transcript summaries request thinking off without changing ordinary chat reasoning, task timeouts, or unrelated model settings. No configuration changes or migration are required. Models that cannot disable reasoning still use their provider's supported minimum and can still exhaust a short budget.

## Why This Change Was Made

The previous reasoning reserve increased output allowances but did not turn thinking off. Utility preparation and the title/transcript callers now select off explicitly; the isolated owner does not add a reasoning reserve for off requests. The final one-shot payload hook keeps configured Ollama and OpenAI-compatible boolean thinking switches from re-enabling it, preserving other payload fields and native provider effort mappings.

## Evidence

- Real title-generation/request assembly against loopback HTTP fixtures passes for native Ollama and OpenAI-compatible transport. Captures verify native think:false, nested and top-level enable_thinking:false, preserved template/sampling/context settings, and unchanged ordinary enabled reasoning. These are wire-contract tests; a live qwen3.6:35b generation was not run.
- Focused utility, isolated-budget, prepared-completion, ordinary embedded parameter, and transcript tests: 92 passed in 52.49s wall time. Final observer/recap/narration/shutdown caller suites: 62 passed in 96.18s. The title transport file: 20 passed, 40.11s test-run duration (native plugin activation and the existing persistence scenarios account for most time).
- Changed owner files through `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs <file> --maxWorkers=1`: isolated budget 7/7 (10.32s wall); prepared completion 21/21 (9.56s wall).
- Independent Codex autoreview: scoped-clean through P2. Subsequent mechanical typed-fixture updates carry the new required thinking-off field.
- Regression control: restoring the five production files to baseline 6d479f5 while keeping the new tests gives exactly five failures (native think:true, the 12,288-token reserve, configured top-level/nested thinking, and agent-specific override precedence). The candidate passes all 20. After the control, source hashes verify exact restoration of the reviewed candidate.
- Core and all 28 selected test typecheck graphs pass, as do formatting, growth/architecture guards, schema, storage, media, import-cycle, and authorization guards. `check:changed` remains red at the dead-export scan: eight production/six full-tree unused exports exactly match a clean baseline 6d479f5 run. Scoped lint has only the unchanged 711-code-line/700-line-cap violation in isolated-completion.ts, also reproduced on that clean baseline. No lint/scan rules or baselines were relaxed. PR CI owns broad behavioral validation; see Checks for the current result.

### ClawSweeper follow-up

- Addressed the [P2 harness-budget finding](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169920#issuecomment-6125498955): observer and recap assertions now require 300/240 tokens plus reasoning off, retaining digest publication, recap persistence, and empty-tool coverage. The old assertions reproduced two failures; the corrected harness passes all four cases. The seven isolated-budget cases also pass (combined focused run: 43.81s). Scoped typecheck, lint, and formatting pass.
- Classified the old-head CI type failures: all report the same number-versus-bigint snapshot identity error in the untouched update migration code. CI checked merge commit 508d53d0ba83f92befa4e8d517d33cf6a4d7fc8c, based on main 418aa6a54a07dae347c32c03a3269d3fe81127ac with fs-safe 0.26.2. Main's direct successor [28df9fe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/28df9fe159fc9fb833d25e2c534d5e780f9e4c50) repairs that exact diagnostic; no unrelated migration changes are included here.
- The live-model limitation remains explicit above; this feedback update changes only the two test expectations, not production behavior.
